title: DETECT Dyad Quantitative Survey
text:
This dashboard monitors consent and survey responses for the quantitative arm of the DETECT-RPC R33 phase (HSC-SPH-24-0123). Care recipients enrolled in a partner home-based primary care program, and the family caregivers who help care for them, are invited to complete an online survey about their health, social support, and safety.




Patients answer the survey about themselves.
Caregivers choose to answer about themselves, or about the person they care for (a proxy survey).

Approximately 125 care recipients and caregivers (250 total) will be surveyed across seven sites: Baylor College of Medicine House Calls, Johns Hopkins Home-Based Medicine, UCSF Care at Home, UAB House Calls, UT Southwestern COVE, LBJ House Calls, and UT Physicians House Calls.



Consent · Sociodemographics · Social Isolation/Support · General Health · Substance Use · Self-Report · Caregiver Questions (caregivers only) · End
